mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (user_id, target_type, target_id, rating, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{rating}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.rating, r.content, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, u.nickname AS author_nickname FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.target_type = #{targetType} AND r.target_id = #{targetId} AND r.status = 'VISIBLE' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attractions WHERE no = #{targetId})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trip_plans WHERE id = #{targetId})
